pr_title: Correctly handle InputStream.read() when it return -1 during writing …
pr_body:
…to the ByteBuf

Motivation:

We didnt correctly handle the case when the InputStream did reach EOF during writing to the ByteBuf and so return -1.

Modifications:

- Correctly handle EOF
- Add unit test

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/11829

issue_context.title: ChunkedStream - readChunk

review_comments: This behaviour could also be made more clear in the javadocs to `writeBytes`. The equivalent `setBytes` calls it out.
Will do a followup PR for that.
